name: Phases 1 to 3's live checks again: nothing regressed, and the rooms map's old wall settings ended on Atlas's walls
a wall's height set from the board is on Atlas's own wall, in the map file, one step of Atlas's undo, shown at once; Atlas's undo takes it back
a material, a width, a window's opening and a door's prop and turn each go onto the record, beside what is there; back to the default takes the key off
a placed light's height is on the light's record, a carried light's on its token; both are in the file and taken off again
on a map Atlas does not hold a wall or a light setting is refused: nothing is written, no map file changes
no console error from Tabletop or Connect across the run; no map of Tabletop's data keeps a wall's or a light's setting of a map Atlas has held
